subject: Anticoagulant Rodenticide Restrictions
overview: The committee heard city updates, approved past minutes, discussed the progress of the Climate Action and Adaptation Plan, and received a detailed presentation on the environmental impacts of anticoagulant rodenticides.

items.title: Meeting Opening and Volunteer Appeals
items.summary: The committee opened with calls for volunteers for the upcoming Harvest Your Energy festival.

items.title: Initial City Updates
items.summary: Sam shared updates from recent community tabling events before a brief power outage interrupted the presentation.

items.title: Resumed City Updates
items.summary: Sam provided updates on McGlynn School solar installations and sustainability planning for the new high school.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the previous meeting.

items.title: Future Presentation Topics
items.summary: The committee discussed potential future presentations on stormwater management, depaving initiatives, and data centers.

items.title: Climate Action and Adaptation Plan Tracking
items.summary: The committee discussed data collection progress and next steps for the five-year review of the Climate Action and Adaptation Plan.

items.title: Rodenticide Impacts on Wildlife
items.summary: Laura Kiesel of Save Arlington Wildlife presented on the ecological dangers of anticoagulant rodenticides, municipal restriction strategies, and alternative pest management methods.
